ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p322/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p322/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p322/r2.claim: Verses 16–19 shift to hypocrites as the Muslims’ hidden enemy: they hear the Prophet but understand nothing, and what strengthens believers’ faith strengthens their hypocrisy.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p322/r2.anchor: These people do apparently listen to what the Prophet (sws) says but understand nothing.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p339/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p339/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p339/r4.claim: God increases the guidance of those who preserve their innate light and nurtures their virtue according to their capacity and desire; hypocrites lose even their innate ability.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-7-english:p339/r4.anchor: God, through His companionship of His Prophet (sws), increased such people in guidance as had kept intact the innate light

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p467#2/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p467#2/r6.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p467#2/r6.claim: The pronoun in زادهم refers to God, as shown by طبع الله and the following وآتاهم; guidance increases through understanding, proofs, and revealed commands, prohibitions, and reports.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p467#2/r6.anchor: والضمير في زادهم عائد على الله، كما أظهره قوله: طبع الله

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p467#2/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p467#2/r7.speaker: قيل
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p467#2/r7.claim: Another view takes the pronoun to refer to the hypocrites’ words and confusion, which prompt believers to praise God for faith and increase their support of the religion.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p467#2/r7.anchor: قيل: ويحتمل أن يعود على قول المنافقين واضطرابهم

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p467#2/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p467#2/r8.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p467#2/r8.claim: وآتاهم تقواهم means God made them God-fearing; تقواهم is a verbal noun attributed to its subject.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v9p467#2/r8.anchor: وآتاهم تقواهم: أي أعطاهم، أي جعلهم متقين له فتقواهم مصدر مضاف للفاعل

RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r1.claim: Guided believers listen, understand, and act on what they know, unlike hypocrites who listen repeatedly without benefit; this contrast also removes the excuse that revelation was obscure.
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r1.anchor: فإنه يستمع فيفهم ، ويعمل بما يعلم ، والمنافق يستعيد ، والمهتدي يفسر ويعيد

RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r2.claim: The guided person's understanding and deduction show that the hypocrite's failure comes from blindness of heart, not from any obscurity in the message.
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r2.anchor: فإن المهتدي فهم واستنبط لوازمه وتوابعه ، فذلك لعماء القلوب ، لا لخفاء المطلوب

RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r3.claim: One possible agent of the increase is what they hear from the Prophet, God's words and the Prophet's words, contrasting their understanding with the hypocrites' failure to understand.
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r3.anchor: المسموع من النبي عليه الصلاة والسلام من كلام الله وكلام الرسول يدل عليه

RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r4.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r4.claim: A second possibility is that God increases the guided in guidance, just as He seals hypocrites' hearts and increases their blindness.
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r4.anchor: أن الله تعالى زادهم ويدل عليه قوله تعالى : { أولئك الذين طبع الله على قلوبهم }

RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r5.claim: A third possibility is that hypocrites' derision itself increases believers' guidance, since believers find the hypocrites' conduct abhorrent and avoid it.
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r5.anchor: الثالث : استهزاء المنافق زاد المهتدي هدى ، ووجهه أنه تعالى لما قال : { واتبعوا أهواءهم }

RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r6.speaker: قيل
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r6.claim: One transmitted explanation takes the phrase to mean that God gives the guided the reward for their piety.
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r6.anchor: قيل فيه إن المراد آتاهم ثواب تقواهم

RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r7.speaker: قيل
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r7.claim: Another transmitted explanation takes it to mean that God gives them piety itself, without an implied word, by showing them what piety is.
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r7.anchor: وقيل آتاهم نفس تقواهم من غير إضمار ، يعني بين لهم التقوى

RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r8.speaker: قيل
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r8.claim: A third transmitted explanation is that God grants them success in acting on what they have learned.
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r8.anchor: وقيل آتاهم توفيق العمل بما علموا

RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r9.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r9.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r9.claim: Rāzī notes that hudā is the verbal noun of هدَى and reads the linked verse as an instruction to follow the guidance by which earlier people were guided.
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r9.anchor: والهدى مصدر من هدى ، قال الله تعالى : { فبهداهم اقتده } ( الأنعام : 90 ) أي خذ بما هدوا واهتد كما هدوا

RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r10.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r10.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r10.claim: Rāzī proposes that the guided are Quran listeners who understand its meanings and explain them to others, advancing from being guided to guiding others.
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r10.anchor: يحتمل أن يكون المراد به بيان حال المستمعين للقرآن الفاهمين لمعانيه المفسرين له

RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r11.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r11.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r11.claim: On this reading, the increase moves them from the rank of people guided to the rank of guides, while they avoid speaking about the Quran without proof or interpreting it by personal opinion.
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r11.anchor: حتى ارتقوا من درجة المهتدين إلى درجة الهادين

RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r12.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r12.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r12.claim: Alternatively, the increase in guidance signals knowledge, while those already guided are careful about matters they do not know, following the best of what they hear and affirming the ambiguous revelation in faith.
RAZI-FULL:v28p51#2/r12.anchor: إشارة إلى الأخذ بالاحتياط فيما لم يعلموه

STUDYQURAN:47:17/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:47:17/r1.speaker: Q, Ṭ
STUDYQURAN:47:17/r1.claim: God increases the guided in faith, knowledge, and insight.
STUDYQURAN:47:17/r1.anchor: God increases those who are guided in faith (Q, Ṭ), knowledge, and insight (Q)

STUDYQURAN:47:17/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:47:17/r2.speaker: Z
STUDYQURAN:47:17/r2.claim: One interpretation is that God helps them attain reverence.
STUDYQURAN:47:17/r2.anchor: helps them attain reverence or that He gives them rewards for their reverence (Z)

STUDYQURAN:47:17/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:47:17/r3.speaker: Z
STUDYQURAN:47:17/r3.claim: Alternatively, God gives them rewards for their reverence.
STUDYQURAN:47:17/r3.anchor: helps them attain reverence or that He gives them rewards for their reverence (Z)

BURSEVI:v8p396#3/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p396#3/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p396#3/r1.claim: Those guided to the path of truth are believers, whom God increases in guidance through enabling and inspiration.
BURSEVI:v8p396#3/r1.anchor: إلى طريق الحق وهم المؤمنون {زادهم} ؛ أي : الله تعالى {هدى} بالتوفيق والإلهام.

BURSEVI:v8p396#3/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p396#3/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v8p396#3/r2.claim: Another explanation is that God creates piety in them or shows them what to guard against.
BURSEVI:v8p396#3/r2.anchor: {والذين اهتدوا} ؛ أي : خلق التقوى فيهم ، أو بين لهم ما يتقون منه.

BURSEVI:v8p396#3/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v8p396#3/r3.speaker: ابن عطاء قدس سره
BURSEVI:v8p396#3/r3.claim: Ibn Ata says those who truly realize their search for guidance are brought to its station and increased in guidance by reaching the Guide.
BURSEVI:v8p396#3/r3.anchor: قال ابن عطاء قدس سره : الذين تحققوا في طلب الهداية أوصلناهم إلى مقام الهداية

TABATABAI:47:16-18/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:47:16-18/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:47:16-18/r1.claim: These verses continue the preceding discussion of diseased hearts, hypocrites, and those who apostatized after faith.
TABATABAI:47:16-18/r1.anchor: بيان الآيات جارية على السياق السابق

TABATABAI:47:16-18/r10.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:47:16-18/r10.speaker: author
TABATABAI:47:16-18/r10.claim: Guidance counters the misguidance that accompanies a sealed heart: it means submitting to sound innate nature and following truth.
TABATABAI:47:16-18/r10.anchor: المراد بالاهتداء ما يقابل الضلال الملازم للطبع على القلب

TABATABAI:47:16-18/r11.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:47:16-18/r11.speaker: author
TABATABAI:47:16-18/r11.claim: God increases their guidance by raising their degree of faith; guidance and faith have multiple degrees.
TABATABAI:47:16-18/r11.anchor: زيادة هداهم من الله سبحانه رفعه تعالى درجة إيمانهم

TABATABAI:47:16-18/r12.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:47:16-18/r12.speaker: author
TABATABAI:47:16-18/r12.claim: Taqwa counters following desires and means scrupulous avoidance of God's prohibitions and sins.
TABATABAI:47:16-18/r12.anchor: المراد بالتقوى ما يقابل اتباع الأهواء وهو الورع عن محارم الله

TABATABAI:47:16-18/r13.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:47:16-18/r13.speaker: author
TABATABAI:47:16-18/r13.claim: The increase in guidance perfects knowledge, while granting taqwa perfects action.
TABATABAI:47:16-18/r13.anchor: زيادة الهدى راجع إلى تكميلهم في ناحية العلم وإيتاء التقوى إلى تكميلهم في ناحية العمل

TABATABAI:47:16-18/r14.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:47:16-18/r14.speaker: author
TABATABAI:47:16-18/r14.claim: By contrast, sealing signifies loss of perfected knowledge and following desires loss of righteous action; this does not conflict with reading the second clause as explanatory of the first.
TABATABAI:47:16-18/r14.anchor: وهذا لا ينافي ما قدمنا أن اتباع الأهواء كعطف التفسير

TABRISI:47:17-19/r1.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:47:17-19/r1.speaker: author
TABRISI:47:17-19/r1.claim: The believers were guided by what they heard from the Prophet.
TABRISI:47:17-19/r1.anchor: بما سمعوا من النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

TABRISI:47:17-19/r2.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:47:17-19/r2.speaker: author
TABRISI:47:17-19/r2.claim: The implied agent of increasing their guidance may be God, Qurʾān recitation, or the Prophet.
TABRISI:47:17-19/r2.anchor: الله أو قراءة القرآن أو النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

TABRISI:47:17-19/r3.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:47:17-19/r3.speaker: author
TABRISI:47:17-19/r3.claim: Another view says the hypocrites' mockery increased believers in faith, knowledge, insight, and confirmation of their Prophet.
TABRISI:47:17-19/r3.anchor: وقيل: زادهم استهزاء المنافقين إيمانا وعلما وبصيرة وتصديقا لنبيهم صلى الله عليه وسلم

TABRISI:47:17-19/r4.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:47:17-19/r4.speaker: author
TABRISI:47:17-19/r4.claim: One explanation is that God enabled them to practice piety.

TABRISI:47:17-19/r5.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:47:17-19/r5.speaker: سعيد بن جبير وأبو علي الجبائي
TABRISI:47:17-19/r5.claim: Saʿīd ibn Jubayr and Abū ʿAlī al-Jubbāʾī explain the phrase as giving them the reward for their piety.
TABRISI:47:17-19/r5.anchor: وقيل: معناه وأتاهم ثواب تقواهم عن سعيد بن جبير وأبي علي الجبائي

TABRISI:47:17-19/r6.author: al-Ṭabrisī
TABRISI:47:17-19/r6.speaker: author
TABRISI:47:17-19/r6.claim: Another explanation is that God showed them what to avoid: leaving dispensations and taking the stricter duties.
TABRISI:47:17-19/r6.anchor: وقيل: بين لهم ما يتقون وهو ترك الرخص والأخذ بالعزائم

THALABI:v9p32#2/r12.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p32#2/r12.speaker: author
THALABI:v9p32#2/r12.claim: Those who are guided are the believers; God increases their guidance and inspires and enables them to be God-fearing.
THALABI:v9p32#2/r12.anchor: والذين اهتدوا يعني المؤمنين. زادهم هدى

THALABI:v9p32#2/r13.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p32#2/r13.speaker: ابن مسعود والأعمش
THALABI:v9p32#2/r13.claim: Ibn Masud and al-Amash read and bestowed on them instead of and gave them.

THALABI:v9p32#2/r14.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p32#2/r14.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
THALABI:v9p32#2/r14.claim: Said ibn Jubayr interprets the phrase as God giving them the reward of their piety.
THALABI:v9p32#2/r14.anchor: وقال سعيد بن جبير: وآتاهم ثواب تقواهم.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r1.speaker: الكلبي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r1.claim: Al-Kalbi identifies those who were guided as the people of Islam.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r2.speaker: عطاء عن ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r2.claim: Ata's report from Ibn Abbas says God increased the guided in guidance.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r3.speaker: أبو صالح عن ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r3.claim: Abu Salih explains that those guided through the abrogated command were increased in guidance through the abrogating command; the abrogator itself may be the added guidance.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r3.anchor: وقال أبو صالح عنه: والذين اهتدوا بالمنسوخ زادهم الله هدى بالناسخ

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r4.speaker: مقاتل بن سليمان
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r4.claim: Muqatil ibn Sulayman says those guided away from error were increased in guidance through the ruling that abrogated the first command.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r4.anchor: وقال مقاتل بن سليمان: والذين اهتدوا من الضلالة زادهم الله هدى

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r5.speaker: مقاتل بن حيان
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r5.claim: Muqatil ibn Hayyan says believers obeyed each command before it was abrogated; God rewards their earlier obedience and adds guidance as they turn to the new command.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r5.anchor: وقال مقاتل بن حيان: والذين اهتدوا هم المؤمنون الذين كانوا يؤمرون بالأمر من طاعة ربهم

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r6.speaker: الفراء وأبو إسحاق
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r6.claim: Al-Farra and Abu Ishaq offer one alternative: the hypocrites' turning away and mockery increased the believers in guidance.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r6.anchor: وذكر الفراء وأبو إسحاق في (زادهم هدى) وجهين آخرين؛ أحدهما: زادهم إعراض المنافقين واستهزاؤهم هدى

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r7.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r7.speaker: الفراء وأبو إسحاق
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r7.claim: Al-Farra and Abu Ishaq offer another alternative: the Prophet's words just spoken increased the believers in guidance.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r7.anchor: والثاني: زادهم ما قال الرسول آنفا هدى

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r8.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r8.speaker: الضحاك
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r8.claim: Al-Dahhak says the believers rejoiced at each revelation from God, and God increased them in guidance through it.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p240#2/r8.anchor: وقال الضحاك: كلما أتاهم من الله تنزيل فرحوا به، فزادهم الله به هدى

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p241/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p241/r1.speaker: الكلبي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p241/r1.claim: Al-Kalbi says God inspired the believers with their piety.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p241/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p241/r2.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p241/r2.claim: Sa'id ibn Jubayr explains the phrase as God inspiring them with the reward for their piety.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p241/r2.anchor: وقال سعيد بن جبير: وألهمهم ثواب تقواهم

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p241/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p241/r3.speaker: ابن حيان
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p241/r3.claim: Ibn Hayyan explains the first interpretation as God enabling them to do what He commanded and obligated.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p241/r3.anchor: فقال في معنى القول الأول: وفقهم للعمل بما أمروا به مما فرض عليهم

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p241/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p241/r4.speaker: ابن حيان
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p241/r4.claim: Ibn Hayyan also reports an interpretation that God gives them the reward for their deeds in the afterlife.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p241/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p241/r5.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p241/r5.claim: The commentary turns next to warn Meccan disbelievers that the Hour is near and that nothing will be accepted from them once it comes.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v20p241/r5.anchor: ثم خوف كفار مكة بقرب الساعة، وأنها إذا أتت لم يقبل منهم شيء

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:47:15-17/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:47:15-17/r4.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:47:15-17/r4.claim: The phrase can mean that God granted them the reward for their piety.

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:47:15-17/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:47:15-17/r5.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:47:15-17/r5.claim: Alternatively, the phrase means that God inspired them with piety and enabled them to practice it.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:47:15-17/r5.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون المعنى: وألهمهم تقواهم ووفقهم لها

ELMALILI:47:12-19#3/r5.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:47:12-19#3/r5.speaker: author
ELMALILI:47:12-19#3/r5.claim: For those who accept guidance, God's or the Prophet's words increase guidance and taqwa, strengthening their sense of protection and readiness to meet God at the appointed hour.
ELMALILI:47:12-19#3/r5.anchor: Allah yahut Peygamber’in söylediği kelâm onların takvâlarını artırmaktadır. Takvâ hislerini, korunmaları esbâbını artırmaktadır.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:47:16/r5.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:47:16/r5.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:47:16/r5.claim: Believers benefit from the Prophet's explanations, use reason soundly, continue along the right path, and make obedience to God central to their conduct.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:47:16/r5.anchor: Müminler ise peygamberlerini dinleyerek onun açıklamalarından yararlanmakta, akıllarını düzgün çalıştırmakta, doğru yolda ilerlemeye devam ederken davranışlarında Allah’a itaati merkeze almaktadırlar.

QUSHAYRI:v3p201/r10.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p201/r10.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p201/r10.claim: Those who strive spiritually gain the lights of witnessing; those who contemplate proof gain the spirit of disclosure.
QUSHAYRI:v3p201/r10.anchor: اهتدوا } : بأنواع المجاهدات ، ( فزادهم هدى ) : بأنوار المشاهدات

QUSHAYRI:v3p201/r11.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p201/r11.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p201/r11.claim: Guidance through reflection on proof is increased by the spirit of divine disclosure.
QUSHAYRI:v3p201/r11.anchor: اهتدوا } : بتأمل البرهان ، ( فزادهم هدى ) بروح البيان

QUSHAYRI:v3p201/r12.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p201/r12.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p201/r12.claim: Knowledge of certainty is followed by the truth of certainty.
QUSHAYRI:v3p201/r12.anchor: اهتدوا } : بعلم اليقين ، ( فزادهم هدى ) : بحق اليقين

QUSHAYRI:v3p201/r13.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p201/r13.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p201/r13.claim: The manners of intimate prayer lead to salvation and elevated ranks.
QUSHAYRI:v3p201/r13.anchor: اهتدوا } : بآداب المناجاة ، ( فزادهم هدى ) : بالنجاة ورفع الدرجات

QUSHAYRI:v3p201/r14.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p201/r14.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p201/r14.claim: Those who recognize the truth and do not dispute it receive further guidance through steadfastness on its paths.
QUSHAYRI:v3p201/r14.anchor: اهتدوا } : إلى ما فيه من الحق ولم يختلفوا في أنه الحق ، ( فزادهم هدى ) بالاستقامة على طرق الحق

SULAMI:v2p247#4/r1.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p247#4/r1.speaker: ابن عطاء
SULAMI:v2p247#4/r1.claim: Ibn ʿAṭāʾ says those who fully pursue guidance are brought to its station and increased in guidance by reaching the Guide.
SULAMI:v2p247#4/r1.anchor: قال ابن عطاء : الذين تحققوا في طلب الهداية أوصلناهم إلى مقام الهداية وزدناهم هدى بالوصول إلى الهادي

FARRA:v3p60/r2.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p60/r2.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p60/r2.claim: Their mockery increases the guidance of those who have been guided.
FARRA:v3p60/r2.anchor: زادهم استهزاؤهم هدى، وآتاهم الله تقواهم

FARRA:v3p60/r3.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p60/r3.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p60/r3.claim: One explanation is that God rewarded them for their piety.

FARRA:v3p60/r4.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p60/r4.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p60/r4.claim: Another explanation is that God inspired them with their piety.
FARRA:v3p60/r4.anchor: ويقال: ألهمهم تقواهم، ويقال: آتاهم تقواهم

FARRA:v3p60/r5.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p60/r5.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p60/r5.claim: A further explanation says they received their piety from the abrogated rule when the abrogating verse came.
FARRA:v3p60/r5.anchor: ويقال: آتاهم تقواهم من المنسوخ إذا نزل الناسخ

NAHHAS:v4p184/r3.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p184/r3.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p184/r3.claim: Those guided accepted the guidance and acted on it.

NAHHAS:v4p184/r4.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p184/r4.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p184/r4.claim: God increases their guidance through revealed verses, proofs, signs, and arguments, increasing insight and knowledge.
NAHHAS:v4p184/r4.anchor: قد ذكرناه ومن حسن ما قيل في الضمير أن المعنى زادهم الله جل وعز هدى بما ينزل من الآيات والبراهين والدلائل والحجج

SAMIN-DURR:47:17/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:47:17/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:47:17/r1.claim: والذين اهتدوا can be nominative as a subject or accusative through الاشتغال.
SAMIN-DURR:47:17/r1.anchor: يجوز فيه الرفع بالابتداء، والنصب على الاشتغال.

SAMIN-DURR:47:17/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:47:17/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:47:17/r2.claim: تقواهم is a verbal noun annexed to its subject.

SAMIN-DURR:47:17/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:47:17/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:47:17/r3.claim: The pronoun in آتاهم may refer to God, the hypocrites' statement that increases believers' piety, or the Messenger.
SAMIN-DURR:47:17/r3.anchor: والضمير في " آتاهم " يعود على الله أو على قول المنافقين؛ لأن قولهم ذلك مما يزيد المؤمنين تقوى،

ZAJJAJ:v5p10/r5.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p10/r5.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p10/r5.claim: The preferred referent of the pronoun in “increased them” is God, so He is the one increasing the guided in guidance.
ZAJJAJ:v5p10/r5.anchor: فأجودها - والله أعلم - أن يكون فيه ذكر الله

ZAJJAJ:v5p11/r1.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p11/r1.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p11/r1.claim: Alternatively, the pronoun may refer to the Messenger: what he said increased the guided in guidance.
ZAJJAJ:v5p11/r1.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون الضمير في (زادهم) قول الرسول - صلى الله عليه وسلم -

ZAJJAJ:v5p11/r2.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p11/r2.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p11/r2.claim: A third possibility is that the hypocrites' turning away and mockery increased the guided in guidance.
ZAJJAJ:v5p11/r2.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون زادهم إعراض المنافقين واستهزاؤهم هدى

ZAJJAJ:v5p11/r3.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p11/r3.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p11/r3.claim: Ātāhum taqwāhum may mean that God inspired them with piety, as in the verse about being made to hold fast to the word of piety.
ZAJJAJ:v5p11/r3.anchor: يجوز أن يكون وألهمهم تقواهم، كما قال عز وجل:

ZAJJAJ:v5p11/r4.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p11/r4.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p11/r4.claim: Alternatively, it means that God gave them the reward for their piety.
ZAJJAJ:v5p11/r4.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون - والله أعلم - وآتاهم ثواب تقواهم

ASAD-NOTES:47:16#n21/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:47:16#n21/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:47:16#n21/r1.claim: Asad glosses taqwahum as God-consciousness given to those who are guided.

ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r1.claim: Those guided to the way of truth are increased by God in guidance through enabling and inspiration.
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r1.anchor: إلى طريق الحق ( زادهم ( أي الله عز وجل ( هدى ( بالتوفيق والإلهام

ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r2.claim: The relative clause can be nominative as subject or accusative after an omitted verb explained by the following verb; the apparent reading is nominative. Hudan is either the second object of zāda or a specification, with the former more apparent, and its indefinite form magnifies it.
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r2.anchor: والموصول يحتمل الرفع على الأبتداء والنصب بفعل محذوف يفسره المذكور

ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r3.claim: God's giving them taqwa can mean creating it in them, as Ashʿaris say of human acts, or creating in them an effective capacity by His permission, as al-Kurani attributes to al-Ashʿari and other investigators; making them God-fearing can fit either account.
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r3.anchor: بأن خلقها فيهم بناء على ما يقوله الأشاعرة في أفعال العباد

ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r4.speaker: البيضاوي
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r4.claim: Al-Baydawi offers three readings: God showed them what to avoid, helped them practice taqwa, or gave them its reward; the wording is figurative in the first two, or literal reward because taqwa causes it, or has an omitted possessive. None conflicts with orthodox doctrine.
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r4.anchor: وقال البيضاوي : أي بين لهم ما يتقون أو أعانهم على تقواهم

ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r5.speaker: الزمخشري
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r5.claim: Al-Zamakhshari mentions helping them in taqwa and giving them its reward from al-Baydawi's alternatives.
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r5.anchor: وذكر الزمخشري الثاني والثالث من ذلك

ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r6.speaker: الطيبي
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r6.claim: Al-Tibi favors the help interpretation: it pairs following desires with receiving taqwa, while sealed hearts pair with increased guidance; perfected taqwa means the knower turns wholly to God, as in the command to fear Him as He deserves.
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r6.anchor: واختار الطيبي الأول من هذين الأثنين وقال : هو أوفق لتأليف النظم الكريم

ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r7.claim: The author says this contrastive arrangement also works with his explanations and with taqwa as guidance about what to avoid; interpreting it as the reward of taqwa is reported from Saʿid ibn Jubayr and al-Jubbaʾi and is more informative without inflating taqwa to its highest degree.
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r7.anchor: وتفسير ذلك بإعطاء جزاء التقوى مروي عن سعيد بن جبير وذهب إليه الجبائي والكلام عليه أفيد

ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r8.speaker: الطيبي
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r8.claim: Al-Tibi pairs those guided against those who followed desires, and increased guidance against hearts sealed; the author says this alignment can also explain the passage without making contrast decisive.
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r8.anchor: إن قوله تعالى ( اهتدوا ) في مقابلة ( اتبعوا أهواءهم ) وقوله سبحانه

ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r9.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r9.claim: One view makes the Prophet, understood from the preceding address, the subject of increased guidance and the giving of taqwa, with a figurative attribution; the author calls it contrary to the apparent sense and says the subject should align with God's sealing of hearts.
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r9.anchor: وقيل : فاعل ( زادهم ) ضمير قوله صلى الله عليه وسلم المفهوم من قوله تعالى

ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r10.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r10.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r10.claim: A very remote suggestion makes the subject the hypocrites' remark, since it might amaze believers and increase their conviction; the author says it is scarcely worth considering.
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r10.anchor: وجوز أن يكون ضميرا عائدا على قول المنافقين فإن ذلك مما يعجب منه المؤمن

ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r11.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r11.speaker: الطيبي
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r11.claim: Al-Tibi reads renouncing desire as turning toward the Master and leaving worldly cravings; following desire is spiritual illness, while abiding by taqwa is divine medicine.
ALUSI-FULL:v26p51#2/r11.anchor: العزوب عن شهوات الحياة الدنيا ثم في إسناد إيتاء التقوى إليه تعالى وإسناد متابعة الهوى إليهم

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p283#3/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p283#3/r3.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p283#3/r3.claim: Those who are guided are the believers.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p283#3/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p283#3/r4.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p283#3/r4.claim: God increased them in guidance through what the Messenger said.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p283#3/r4.anchor: ما قال الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p283#3/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p283#3/r5.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p283#3/r5.claim: God enabled them to act on what He commanded, which is taqwā.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p283#3/r5.anchor: وفقهم للعمل بما أمرهم به، وهو التقوى

BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p283#3/r6.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p283#3/r6.speaker: سعيد بن جبير
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p283#3/r6.claim: Saʿīd ibn Jubayr says the phrase means that God gave them the reward of their taqwā.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v7p283#3/r6.anchor: قال سعيد بن جبير: وآتاهم ثواب تقواهم

BAYDAWI-FULL:47:16-17/r8.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:47:16-17/r8.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:47:16-17/r8.claim: God increases the guidance of those already guided through enabling grace and inspiration, or through the Messenger's words.
BAYDAWI-FULL:47:16-17/r8.anchor: أي زادهم الله بالتوفيق والإلهام، أو قول الرسول عليه الصلاة والسلام

BAYDAWI-FULL:47:16-17/r9.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:47:16-17/r9.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:47:16-17/r9.claim: God gives them their taqwā by explaining what to avoid, helping them practice it, or granting its reward.
BAYDAWI-FULL:47:16-17/r9.anchor: بين لهم ما يتقون أو أعانهم على تقواهم، أو أعطاهم جزاءها

BIQAI-FULL:v7p162/r13.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p162/r13.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p162/r13.claim: The guided strive through listening to follow primordial nature, attain guidance through sincere faith and surrender, and undertake varied spiritual exertions.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p162/r13.anchor: اجتهدوا باستماعهم منك في مطاوعة داعي الفطرة الأولى إلى الوقوع على الهدى بالصدق

BIQAI-FULL:v7p162/r14.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p162/r14.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p162/r14.claim: God increases their guidance by opening and illuminating their hearts with the lights of spiritual witnessing, making them vessels of wisdom.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p162/r14.anchor: بأن شرح صدورهم ونورها بأنوار المشاهدات فصارت أوعية للحكمة

BIQAI-FULL:v7p162/r15.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p162/r15.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p162/r15.claim: The author links the increase of guidance to the verse saying that the Lord guides believers who do good by their faith.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p162/r15.anchor: إن الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات يهديهم ربهم بإيمانهم

BIQAI-FULL:v7p162/r16.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p162/r16.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v7p162/r16.claim: God shows them what to fear and enables them to avoid it despite desire; they are the first group described as standing on clear proof from their Lord.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p162/r16.anchor: بين لهم ما هو أهل لأن يحذر ووفقهم لاجتنابه مخالفة للهوى , فهم القسم الأول

BIQAI-FULL:v7p162/r17.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v7p162/r17.speaker: ابن برجان
BIQAI-FULL:v7p162/r17.claim: Ibn Barjan says piety is the action of faith, just as the limbs' deeds are the action of Islam.
BIQAI-FULL:v7p162/r17.anchor: قال ابن برجان : التقوى عمل الإيمان كما أن أعمال الجوارح عمل الإسلام

DURR-FULL:v7p466/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p466/r1.speaker: عكرمة
DURR-FULL:v7p466/r1.claim: ʿIkrima describes People of the Book who had believed in their prophets and Muhammad before his mission but rejected him afterward; he links them to the verse about faces darkened after faith.
DURR-FULL:v7p466/r1.anchor: عن عكرمة رضي الله عنه أن ناسا من أهل الكتاب آمنوا برسلهم وصدقوهم وآمنوا بمحمد صلى الله عليه وسلم قبل أن يبعث

DURR-FULL:v7p466/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p466/r2.speaker: أهل الكتاب
DURR-FULL:v7p466/r2.claim: The report contrasts other People of the Book who believed in their prophets and Muhammad before his mission and then believed in him when he was sent; they are the guided whose guidance increased.
DURR-FULL:v7p466/r2.anchor: وكان قوم من أهل الكتاب آمنوا برسلهم وبمحمد صلى الله عليه وسلم قبل أن يبعث فلما بعث آمنوا به

DURR-FULL:v7p466/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v7p466/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v7p466/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says the Quran first guided believers, then their guidance increased when they learned which rulings were abrogating and abrogated.
DURR-FULL:v7p466/r3.anchor: عن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما في قوله {والذين اهتدوا زادهم هدى وآتاهم تقواهم} قال: لما أنزل القرآن آمنوا به فكان هدى

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r1.claim: After the hypocrites of 47:16, God mentions believers to show the contrast and credits them with seeking guidance, pointing to their own effort.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r1.anchor: عقب ذلك بذكر المؤمنين ليبين الفرق، وشرفهم بإسناد فعل الاهتداء إليهم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r2.claim: One possibility is that God is the agent: He increases understanding and evidence or sends laws, prohibitions, and reports, so their guidance grows with their knowledge and belief by His grace.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r2.anchor: والزيادة في هذا المعنى تكون إما بزيادة التفهيم والأدلة، وإما بورود الشرائع والنواهي والأخبار

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r3.claim: Another possibility is that the hypocrites’ statements and confusion cause the increase: believers marvel, thank God for their faith, and gain further insight, with the cause expressed as agent.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r3.anchor: ويحتمل أن يكون الفاعل في: زادهم قول المنافقين واضطرابهم، لأن ذلك مما يتعجب المؤمن منه ويحمد الله على إيمانه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r4.speaker: فرقة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r4.claim: A group says the verse concerns Christians who believed in Muhammad: they had been guided in belief in Jesus, then Muhammad became the cause of further guidance when they believed in him.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r4.anchor: وقالت فرقة: إن هذه الآية نزلت في قوم من النصارى، آمنوا بمحمد

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r5.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r5.claim: The agent in the giving of their taqwa varies with the preceding interpretations, but the strongest account makes God the agent; He made them God-fearing.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r5.anchor: والفاعل في آتاهم يتصرف بحسب التأويلات المذكورة، وأقواها أن الفاعل الله تعالى

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r6.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r6.claim: آتاهم means gave them, here meaning that God made them fear Him: their taqwa of Him.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r6.anchor: وآتاهم معناه: أعطاهم، أي جعلهم متقين له، فالتقدير: تقواهم إياه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r7.speaker: الأعمش
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r7.claim: Al-Aʿmash read وأنطاهم تقواهم, with the same meaning as أعطاهم; Muhammad ibn Talha transmitted it from his father, and it appears in ʿAbd Allah’s codex.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p115#2/r7.anchor: وقرأ الأعمش: «وأنطاهم تقواهم» ، وهي بمعنى أعطاهم

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r1.speaker: الجمهور
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r1.claim: Most commentators identify those guided as the Muslims.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r2.speaker: عكرمة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r2.claim: Ikrima identifies them as people of Scripture who believed in their prophets and then accepted Muhammad when he was sent.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r2.anchor: والثاني قوم من أهل الكتاب كانوا على الإيمان بأنبيائهم وبمحمد صلى الله عليه وسلم

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r3.speaker: الزجاج
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r3.claim: Al-Zajjaj records three explanations of who increased their guidance: God, the Messenger's words, or the hypocrites' mockery that increased believers' guidance.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r3.anchor: وفي الذي زادهم ثلاثة أقوال أحدها أنه الله عز وجل والثاني قول الرسول

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r4.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r4.claim: Guidance is explained either as knowledge or as insight.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r4.anchor: وفي معنى الهدى قولان أحدهما أنه العلم والثاني البصيرة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r5.speaker: السدي
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r5.claim: Al-Suddi says God gives them the reward for their piety in the afterlife.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r5.anchor: أحدها ثواب تقواهم في الآخرة قاله السدي

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r6.speaker: عطية
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r6.claim: Atiyya says He enables them to avoid abrogated rulings and act on abrogating ones.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r6.anchor: والثاني اتقاء المنسوخ والعمل بالناسخ قاله عطية

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r7.speaker: أبو سليمان الدمشقي
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r7.claim: Abu Sulayman al-Dimashqi says God gave them piety along with guidance, so they avoided disobedience from fear of punishment.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v7p402#2/r7.anchor: والثالث أعطاهم التقوى مع الهدى فاتقوا معصيته خوفا من عقوبته

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p315/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p315/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p315/r4.claim: Those who seek guidance are enabled by God to find it, remain firm in it, and receive more of it.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p315/r4.anchor: وفقهم الله لها فهداهم إليها، وثبتهم عليها وزادهم منها

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p315/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p315/r5.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v7p315/r5.claim: God grants them their God-consciousness by inspiring them with right judgment.

JISHUMI:v9p6454/r20.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6454/r20.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v9p6454/r20.claim: The preceding listeners did not listen seeking guidance and were hypocrites; a rational person should listen and reflect to learn the truth.
JISHUMI:v9p6454/r20.anchor: أن القوم لم يستمعوا للاسترشاد، وأنهم كانوا منافقين، وأنه ينبغي للعاقل أن يستمع ويتفكر؛ ليعلم الحق

JISHUMI:v9p6454/r21.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6454/r21.speaker: قتادة
JISHUMI:v9p6454/r21.claim: Qatāda describes two listeners: one heedless of God who gains nothing from hearing, and one mindful of God who benefits from what he hears.
JISHUMI:v9p6454/r21.anchor: وعن قتادة: هؤلاء رجلان: رجل غفل عن الله فما انتفع بما سمع، ورجل لم يغفل عن الله فانتفع بما سمع

JISHUMI:v9p6455/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v9p6455/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v9p6455/r1.claim: An increase in guidance is divine لطف, not God's creation of faith as the Mujabbira claim.
JISHUMI:v9p6455/r1.anchor: أن زيادة الهدى الألطاف منه دون خلق الإيمان على ما تزعمه المجبرة

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r12.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r12.speaker: الفراء
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r12.claim: Al-Farra says the hypocrites' mockery itself increased believers' guidance.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r12.anchor: أحدها : أن الإستهزاء زاد المؤمنين هدى , قاله الفراء .

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r13.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r13.speaker: ابن جريج
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r13.claim: Ibn Jurayj says the Qur'an increased believers' guidance.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r13.anchor: الثاني : أن القرآن زادهم هدى , قاله ابن جريج .

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r14.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r14.speaker: عطية
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r14.claim: Attiya says knowledge of abrogating and abrogated rulings increased their guidance.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r14.anchor: الثالث : أن الناسخ والمنسوخ زادهم هدى , قاله عطية .

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r15.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r15.speaker: الربيع بن أنس
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r15.claim: Al-Rabi ibn Anas says the increase in guidance is an increase in knowledge.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r15.anchor: أحدها : زادهم علما , قاله الربيع بن أنس .

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r16.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r16.speaker: الضحاك
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r16.claim: Al-Dahhak says they understood what they heard and acted on what they learned.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r16.anchor: الثاني : علموا ما سمعوا , وعلموا بما عملوا , قاله الضحاك .

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r17.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r17.speaker: الكلبي
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r17.claim: Al-Kalbi says they gained insight in religion and affirmed their Prophet.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r17.anchor: الثالث : زادهم بصيرة في دينهم وتصديقا لنبيهم ، قاله الكلبي .

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r18.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r18.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r18.claim: Another view is that God opened their hearts further to the faith they already held.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r18.anchor: الرابع : شرح صدورهم بما هم عليه من الإيمان .

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r19.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r19.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r19.claim: Mawardi suggests those guided by truth receive further guidance toward truth.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r19.anchor: ويحتمل خامسا : والذين اهتدوا بالحق زادهم هدى للحق .

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r20.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r20.speaker: الربيع
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r20.claim: Al-Rabi says God gave them fear of Him.

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r21.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r21.speaker: السدي
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r21.claim: Al-Suddi says God gave them the reward for piety in the afterlife.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r21.anchor: الثاني : ثواب تقواهم في الآخرة ، قاله السدي

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r22.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r22.speaker: مقاتل
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r22.claim: Muqatil says God enabled them to perform what had been made obligatory.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r22.anchor: قاله مقاتل . الرابع : بين لهم ما يتقون

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r23.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r23.speaker: ابن زياد
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r23.claim: Ibn Ziyad says God explained what they should avoid.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r23.anchor: الرابع : بين لهم ما يتقون , قاله ابن زياد .

MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r24.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r24.speaker: عطية
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r24.claim: Attiya says this means abandoning abrogated rulings and following abrogating ones.
MAWARDI-FULL:v5p297/r24.anchor: الخامس : أنه ترك المنسوخ والعمل بالناسخ ، قاله عطية .

MUQATIL:47:17/r1.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:47:17/r1.speaker: author
MUQATIL:47:17/r1.claim: God increases the guidance of those who leave error through the decisive verses that abrogated the earlier command.

MUQATIL:47:17/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:47:17/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:47:17/r2.claim: God gave them piety by teaching them to act on the decisive text until they understood it.
MUQATIL:47:17/r2.anchor: وبين لهم التقوى، يعني عملا بالمحكم حتى علموا بالمحكم

NASAFI-FULL:v4p148#2/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p148#2/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p148#2/r1.claim: Those guided by faith and listening to the Qur'an receive increased guidance, meaning insight and knowledge, or an opening of their hearts.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p148#2/r1.anchor: اى بصيرة وعلما أو شرح صدورهم

NASAFI-FULL:v4p148#2/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p148#2/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p148#2/r2.claim: “He gave them their Godwariness” may mean He inspired them to it, rewarded their piety, or showed them what to avoid.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p148#2/r2.anchor: اعلنهم عليها أو آتاهم جزاء تقواهم

QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r14.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r14.claim: Those guided are those guided to faith.
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r14.anchor: { والذين اهتدوا } أي للإيمان زادهم الله هدى

QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r15.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r15.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r15.claim: One view says God increased their guidance.

QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r16.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r16.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r16.claim: Another view says the Prophet increased their guidance.
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r16.anchor: وقيل: زادهم النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم هدى

QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r17.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r17.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r17.claim: Another interpretation says the Qurʾān they heard was guidance that multiplied their certainty.
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r17.anchor: وقيل: ما يستمعونه من القرآن هدى أي يتضاعف يقينهم

QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r18.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r18.speaker: الفراء
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r18.claim: Al-Farrāʾ says the hypocrites’ turning away and mockery itself increased the believers’ guidance.
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r18.anchor: وقال الفراء: زادهم إعراض المنافقين واستهزاؤهم هدى

QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r19.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r19.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r19.claim: Another interpretation is that the descent of abrogating revelation increased their guidance.

QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r20.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r20.speaker: الربيع بن أنس
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r20.claim: Of four explanations for increased guidance, al-Rabīʿ ibn Anas says it means increased knowledge.
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r20.anchor: أحدها زادهم علما قاله الربيع بن أنس

QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r21.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r21.speaker: الضحاك
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r21.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk says they understood what they heard and acted on what they knew.
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r21.anchor: الثاني أنهم علموا ما سمعوا وعملوا بما علموا قاله الضحاك

QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r22.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r22.speaker: الكلبي
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r22.claim: Al-Kalbī says their guidance was greater insight into their religion and affirmation of their Prophet.
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r22.anchor: الثالث زادهم بصيرة في دينهم وتصديقا لنبيهم قاله الكلبي

QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r23.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r23.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r23.claim: The fourth explanation is that God opened their breasts to the faith they already held.
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r23.anchor: الرابع شرح صدورهم بما هم عليه من الإيمان

QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r24.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r24.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r24.claim: One explanation is that God inspired them with their piety.

QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r25.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r25.speaker: الربيع
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r25.claim: Al-Rabīʿ interprets the piety given to them as fear of God.

QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r26.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r26.speaker: السدي
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r26.claim: Al-Suddī says it means the reward for their piety in the afterlife.
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r26.anchor: الثاني ثواب تقواهم في الآخرة قاله السدي

QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r27.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r27.speaker: مقاتل
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r27.claim: Muqātil interprets it as God enabling them to perform what He obligated.
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r27.anchor: الثالث وفقهم للعمل الذي فرض عليهم قاله مقاتل

QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r28.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r28.speaker: ابن زياد، السدي
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r28.claim: Ibn Ziyād and al-Suddī say God showed them what they should avoid.
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r28.anchor: الرابع بين لهم ما يتقون قاله ابن زياد والسدي أيضا

QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r29.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r29.speaker: عطية
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r29.claim: ʿAṭiyya says it means leaving the abrogated ruling and acting by the abrogating one.
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r29.anchor: الخامس أنه ترك المنسوخ والعمل بالناسخ قاله عطية

QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r30.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r30.speaker: الماوردي
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r30.claim: Al-Māwardī adds a sixth possibility: leaving dispensations and choosing the stricter obligations.
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r30.anchor: الماوردي: ويحتمل. سادسا أنه ترك الرخص والأخذ بالعزائم

QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r31.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r31.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r31.claim: A variant reading uses aʿṭāhum (“gave them”) instead of ātāhum.

QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r32.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r32.speaker: عكرمة
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r32.claim: ʿIkrima says this passage was revealed concerning those among the People of the Book who believed.
QURTUBI-FULL:47:16-17/r32.anchor: وقال عكرمة: هذه نزلت فيمن آمن من أهل الكتاب
